The following is a list of frequently asked questions that players have sent us. Otherwise email us at [mailto:rules@profounddecisions.co.uk rules@profounddecisions.co.uk] with any questions about the rules or [mailto:empire@profounddecisions.co.uk empire@profounddecisions.co.uk] with any other questions about the game.
